Submit the online admission application in the announced window (scholarships generally Jan–Mar)
Admitted students are considered automatically and notified by email
peking-university-international-student-.costs: Tuition waiver, living allowance and medical insurance for four years (annual review required).

aud-mohammed-bin-rashid-undergraduate-sc.about:
The American University in Dubai (AUD) is a private American-style university in Dubai Media City offering a range of English-taught bachelor's degrees, including communication through its Mohammed Bin Rashid School for Communication. Since 1999 it has offered scholarships bearing the name of H.H. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, created to reward academic excellence and respond to financial need.

The scholarship is open to all nationalities and all undergraduate programmes. High-school applicants need at least a 90% average (or equivalent), and financial need (insufficient means to fund the degree) is also considered. Depending on the Scholarship Committee's decision, it gives a partial or full tuition waiver, granted for the first year and maintained until graduation as long as the conditions are met.

Awards are made for fall entry only and applications are submitted through AUD's dedicated scholarship portal; apply together with your Fall 2027 admission application.
highlights: Partial to full tuition waiver
Open to all nationalities and programmes
Renewable until graduation
aud-mohammed-bin-rashid-undergraduate-sc.eligibility: First-year applicants of any nationality with a 90%+ high-school average (or equivalent) entering an AUD undergraduate programme in fall; financial need is also considered.
how_to_apply: Apply for Fall 2027 admission to AUD
Submit the scholarship application through AUD's scholarship portal
Provide evidence of financial need if requested
Keep the required academic standing to renew
aud-mohammed-bin-rashid-undergraduate-sc.costs: Partial or full tuition waiver decided by the Scholarship Committee; housing and living costs not included.

ceu-bachelor-partial-tuition-award-2027.about:
Central European University, founded in Budapest and now based in Vienna, offers small, research-oriented English-taught bachelor's programmes such as Data Science and Society and Culture, Politics and Society, and accredited in both Austria and the United States. A small number of merit-based Partial Tuition Awards are available to bachelor's students from any country, covering up to 50% of the tuition fee (up to €4,000 per academic year).

You ask to be considered by ticking the Funding section of the CEU application form. Institutional aid is awarded only in the first two admission rounds: Round 1 closed on 15 October 2026 and Round 2 closes on 2 February 2027 (not open to applicants from visa-sensitive countries, who should have used Round 1). Admitted students pay a €500 registration fee; the application fee is €30.
highlights: Up to 50% of tuition (max €4,000/year)
Open to all nationalities, merit-based
Last chance: Round 2 closes 2 February 2027
ceu-bachelor-partial-tuition-award-2027.eligibility: Applicants of any nationality to a full-time CEU bachelor's programme for 2027 entry who request funding in the application; Round 2 excludes visa-sensitive countries.
how_to_apply: Choose up to three CEU bachelor's programmes
Complete the CEU online application (fee €30) and tick the Funding section
Submit by 2 February 2027 (Round 2)
Funding decisions are sent with admission offers
ceu-bachelor-partial-tuition-award-2027.costs: Award covers up to 50% of tuition, capped at €4,000/year. Living costs in Vienna (about €1,100+/month) are self-funded.

bilkent-international-student-scholarshi.about:
Bilkent University in Ankara was Türkiye's first private, non-profit university and is known for engineering, computer science, economics, business, and music and performing arts, all taught in English. International applicants who want financial support are assessed on their high-school grades, national or international exam scores (e.g. SAT, IB, A-levels), programme choice and other academic criteria.

Tuition waivers are awarded at five levels from 20% to 100% in 20% steps, and a limited number of top students holding a full waiver may also receive accommodation. Scholarships last up to 10 semesters for four-year degrees provided you take the minimum course load and keep an annual GPA of at least 2.00 (2.50 for accommodation). Later, top-5% students can earn merit waivers. Applicants who hold or have held Turkish citizenship are not eligible.
highlights: Tuition waivers of 20%–100%
Possible dorm place for top full-waiver students
Assessed automatically from your application
bilkent-international-student-scholarshi.eligibility: International applicants (never Turkish citizens) applying to a Bilkent undergraduate programme, with strong high-school grades and accepted exam scores.
how_to_apply: Prepare transcripts, exam scores (SAT/ACT, IB, A-levels or national exams) and English proficiency
Apply through Bilkent's online international application form during the 2027 window
Indicate you are seeking financial assistance
Receive the scholarship level with your admission decision
bilkent-international-student-scholarshi.costs: Waiver covers 20–100% of tuition (Bilkent international tuition is roughly US$15,000–$20,000 a year). Living costs in Ankara are relatively low.

sabanci-university-international-undergr.about:
Sabancı University in Istanbul is a research-intensive English-medium private university known for its interdisciplinary first year and strengths in engineering, computer science, economics and management. International applicants who meet the requirements are automatically considered for admission scholarships, and the scholarship section of the application is optional.

The Scholarship Committee weighs academic background, reference letters, exam results, transcripts, interview results and evidence of achievements such as competition prizes or olympiad certificates. Scholarship numbers are limited at every level, early applicants get priority, and a set score does not guarantee a given level. Once awarded at admission, the scholarship continues for the regular length of the degree. Students can also request in-study scholarships after two strong semesters.
highlights: Automatic consideration for all international applicants
Holds for the whole degree once awarded
Early applicants get priority
sabanci-university-international-undergr.eligibility: International applicants meeting Sabancı's undergraduate requirements (one accepted exam/diploma with a valid score, official transcript, language proficiency if required).
how_to_apply: Create an account on the Sabancı application portal when the Fall 2027 cycle opens (expected December 2026)
Upload transcript, exam/diploma score, language score, references and achievements
Optionally complete the scholarship section
Attend an interview if invited; the scholarship decision comes with admission
sabanci-university-international-undergr.costs: Scholarship levels (share of tuition) are not published. Sabancı tuition for international students is roughly US$20,000+ a year.

franklin-university-switzerland-merit-aw.about:
Franklin University Switzerland in Lugano is a small, US-accredited liberal-arts university offering English-taught bachelor's degrees in international relations, business, economics, environmental studies and more, with academic travel built into the curriculum. Merit awards are given automatically at admission based on recalculated GPA: for international students CHF 21,500 (GPA 3.80–4.00), CHF 17,500 (3.50–3.79), CHF 13,000 (3.00–3.49) or CHF 3,000 (below 3.00) per year, renewable for seven semesters. Students on the lower Swiss/EU/EEA tuition rate are not eligible.

Special awards can be added on top, such as the Franklin Honors Program Award ($3,000–$10,000, deadline 1 December), the Ambassador Wilfried Geens Award ($3,000, IB/AP students) and awards for sustainability and creative practice (deadlines 1 March). Note that international tuition is high (about CHF 52,750 plus fees), so even the top merit award covers well under half.
highlights: CHF 3,000–21,500 per year, automatic
Stackable special awards up to $10,000
Priority deadline 1 December 2026
franklin-university-switzerland-merit-aw.eligibility: International (non-Swiss/EU-rate) first-year applicants to Franklin's bachelor's programmes; award tier set by recalculated high-school GPA.
how_to_apply: Apply through Franklin's admissions portal (priority by 1 December 2026)
Merit award is calculated automatically from your transcript
For special awards, submit the extra statement/portfolio/interview by 1 December or 1 March
Receive the award with your admission letter
franklin-university-switzerland-merit-aw.costs: International tuition about CHF 52,750 a year plus ~CHF 2,650 fees; merit award reduces this by CHF 3,000–21,500. Housing and Swiss health insurance are extra.

leiden-university-college-financial-supp.about:
Leiden University College The Hague (LUC) is Leiden University's selective, residential honours college offering the Liberal Arts and Sciences: Global Challenges bachelor's in English. For 2027-28 the non-EU/EEA tuition is €18,050 (€21,120 including the institutional fee). Because the Dutch NL Scholarship is not available at Leiden for 2026-27 and 2027-28, LUC's own Financial Support Programme is the main aid for incoming international students.

Awards are €1,000–€3,000 a year, normally for up to three years and reviewed annually. You need documentary evidence that you cannot study at LUC without support, and you must be (conditionally) admitted during the March–May selection period. Applicants upload a motivation letter, a financial plan on LUC's template and supporting documents in uSis.
highlights: €1,000–€3,000 per year for up to 3 years
All nationalities, based on financial need
Window expected 1 Dec 2026 – 15 Mar 2027
leiden-university-college-financial-supp.eligibility: Prospective LUC students of any nationality who have applied for admission, are (conditionally) admitted during selection, hold no prior bachelor's or master's degree, and can document financial need.
how_to_apply: Apply to LUC via uSis, preferably before 1 December 2026
In uSis, open the 'Scholarship' tile on your LUC application
Upload a motivation letter, LUC financial-plan template and supporting documents
Submit before 15 March (expected); decisions around 21 April; accept within 2 weeks
leiden-university-college-financial-supp.costs: €1,000–€3,000 a year against non-EU tuition of €18,050 (€21,120 incl. institutional fee) plus housing.

st-andrews-ba-international-honours-scho.about:
The BA (International Honours) is a four-year joint degree between the University of St Andrews and William & Mary in the USA: students spend two years at each and choose Classics, Film Studies, Economics, English, History or International Relations. The Scholarship for Excellence is for gifted students entering the first year in 2027, selected purely on academic merit, and open to Scottish, rest-of-UK and overseas applicants with no geographical restriction.

Scholars represent the university at events and in publications. The value will be confirmed by early December 2026 and the award runs for four years. You can apply once you have submitted your course application (an offer is not needed). The application window closes on 17 March 2027 and the BA (International Honours) Common Application deadline is 1 May 2027.
highlights: Four-year merit award for the St Andrews–William & Mary joint BA
Open to all nationalities
Closes 17 March 2027
st-andrews-ba-international-honours-scho.eligibility: Students entering year one of the BA (International Honours) with William & Mary in 2027 (Classics, Film Studies, Economics, English, History or International Relations), any fee status, with academic excellence.
how_to_apply: Apply to the BA (International Honours) via UCAS or the Common Application (final deadline 1 May 2027)
Log in to the St Andrews My Application portal two working days later
Complete the BA International Honours scholarship application
Submit by 17 March 2027; results the week of 22 April 2027
st-andrews-ba-international-honours-scho.costs: Value to be confirmed by December 2026. Tuition is charged by the institution where you study each year.

st-andrews-international-accommodation-a.about:
St Andrews' International Accommodation Award helps overseas-fee undergraduates with financial need meet housing costs in a small town where accommodation is a major expense. It is worth £1,900 a year for the duration of the course: paid towards University halls in the first instance, or as ten monthly maintenance payments (with a double payment in February) if you live privately.

You apply through the same International Undergraduate Scholarships form as the need-based tuition scholarship, two working days after submitting your course application, without waiting for an offer. Information is considered holistically and only used for scholarship assessment.
highlights: £1,900 per year for the whole course
Same form as the International Undergraduate Scholarship
Closes 27 January 2027
st-andrews-international-accommodation-a.eligibility: Entrant undergraduates with overseas fee status starting a St Andrews degree in 2027 who demonstrate financial need.
how_to_apply: Apply to St Andrews (UCAS or Common Application)
Two working days later, open the International Undergraduate Scholarships form in My Application
Select the Accommodation Award and give household income details
Submit by 27 January 2027
st-andrews-international-accommodation-a.costs: £1,900 a year towards accommodation (University halls cost roughly £7,000–£10,000 a year).

imperial-rio-tinto-undergraduate-scholar.about:
Funded by the mining company Rio Tinto, this Imperial College London scholarship pays full overseas tuition fees and a stipend of £17,082 a year to three new undergraduates in the Department of Earth Science and Engineering. Eligible degrees are the BSc and MSci in Earth and Planetary Science, Geology and Geophysics (including the year-abroad variants).

It is limited to applicants ordinarily resident in Argentina, Guinea, Madagascar, China, Mongolia or South Africa. You need a conditional or unconditional offer and must complete the scholarship form by 28 May 2027. Selection is on academic achievement and potential and on the application, with decisions after A-level results in August.
highlights: Full overseas tuition + £17,082 a year
3 awards for geology, geophysics and earth science
Residents of Argentina, Guinea, Madagascar, China, Mongolia, South Africa
imperial-rio-tinto-undergraduate-scholar.eligibility: New entrants ordinarily resident in Argentina, Guinea, Madagascar, China, Mongolia or South Africa holding an offer for a full-time BSc/MSci in Imperial's Department of Earth Science and Engineering.
how_to_apply: Apply to an Earth Science and Engineering BSc/MSci via UCAS (deadline 13 January 2027)
Receive a conditional or unconditional offer
Complete the Rio Tinto Scholarship application form by 28 May 2027
Await the decision within three weeks of mid-August results
imperial-rio-tinto-undergraduate-scholar.costs: Full overseas tuition (about £40,000+ a year) and a £17,082 annual stipend.

ediss-erasmus-mundus-2027.about:
EDISS (Engineering of Data-intensive Intelligent Software Systems) is a two-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master coordinated by Åbo Akademi University in Turku, Finland, with Mälardalen University (Västerås, Sweden), the University of the Balearic Islands (Palma, Spain) and the University of L'Aquila (Italy). Students take a common first year and choose a second-year specialisation, such as Computer Vision and Intelligent Systems in Palma.

It is for graduates with a strong university background in computer science, software engineering or applied mathematics; IT work experience does not replace that. Only TOEFL or IELTS (not online versions) are accepted, with exemptions for some English-taught degrees.

Intake 7 starts in August 2027. The Erasmus Mundus and EDISS scholarship round opens 16 November 2026 and closes 12 January 2027. EMJM scholars get a €9,000/year tuition waiver plus €1,400 a month for 24 months (total €51,600); EDISS scholars get the waiver plus €800/month in year 1 and €310/month in year 2. A later round offers tuition waivers only.
highlights: Software, data and AI across four countries
EMJM package worth €51,600; EDISS scholarships too
Scholarship deadline 12 January 2027
ediss-erasmus-mundus-2027.eligibility: Any nationality. Bachelor's (or equivalent) in computer science, software engineering or applied mathematics from an accredited university; TOEFL or IELTS (no online versions) unless exempt. Former Erasmus Mundus scholarship holders cannot apply for another.
how_to_apply: Read the admission requirements and country-specific document rules
Prepare transcripts, diploma, CV, motivation letter, references and TOEFL/IELTS
Apply in the scholarship round between 16 November 2026 and 12 January 2027 (15:00 Helsinki)
Update enclosures until 19 January 2027 if needed
ediss-erasmus-mundus-2027.costs: Participation cost €9,000 per year. EMJM scholarship: tuition waiver + €1,400/month for 24 months (€51,600 total). EDISS scholarship: tuition waiver + €800/month (year 1) and €310/month (year 2). Tuition-waiver scholarship: €18,000 over two years.

tfmasa-erasmus-mundus-2027.about:
TFMASA (Transfers-Fluids-Materials for Aeronautics Sustainable Applications) is a two-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in aerospace engineering. Students study fluid mechanics, heat transfer and advanced materials for sustainable aviation across the University of Bordeaux (France), UCLouvain in Louvain-la-Neuve (Belgium, semester 2) and BTU Cottbus-Senftenberg (Germany, semester 3), followed by a research or industry thesis.

It suits graduates in mechanical, aerospace, materials or energy engineering or applied physics.

The 2027–2029 call runs from 1 September to 1 December 2026 (10:00 CET) for both scholarship and self-funded candidates; late applications are rejected automatically. EMJM scholars receive €1,400 a month plus a €4,500/year contribution to participation costs paid to the programme; no nationality may take more than 10% of awards.
highlights: Aerospace engineering in Bordeaux, Louvain-la-Neuve and Cottbus
EMJM: €1,400/month + participation costs covered
Deadline 1 December 2026
tfmasa-erasmus-mundus-2027.eligibility: Any nationality. Engineering or physics bachelor's (see the programme's how-to-apply page for exact prerequisites) and English proficiency. Not open to previous Erasmus Mundus scholarship holders; full-time enrolment; no other EU grant during the programme.
how_to_apply: Read the call and key dates on tfmasa.com
Prepare transcripts, CV, motivation letter, references and English proof
Submit the online application before 1 December 2026, 10:00 CET
Attend an interview in mid-February if shortlisted
tfmasa-erasmus-mundus-2027.costs: EMJM scholarship: €1,400 per month for living costs plus €4,500 per year toward tuition and insurance (paid directly to the programme). Erasmus+ mobility support of about €520/month may be available for some semesters for other students.

deai-erasmus-mundus-2027.about:
DEAI (Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence) is a two-year, English-taught Erasmus Mundus Joint Master coordinated by Université libre de Bruxelles, with Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (Barcelona), the University of Padua, TU Wien (Vienna) and Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1. It builds on the long-running BDMA big-data master and offers five specialisations in data management, analytics and AI.

It welcomes computer science and related graduates. You need a bachelor's (180 ECTS) from a university listed in WHED or the THE, ARWU or QS rankings, and English at B2 (IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72). Final-year students may apply.

Scholarship applications for 2027–2029 close on 11 January 2027 (12:00 GMT, strict), with reference letters by 18 January. Self-funded and partial-grant applications run from 1 March to 15 May 2027 (non-EU) or 30 May 2027 (EU). Erasmus Mundus scholarships follow the EU standard of €1,400 a month plus participation costs.
highlights: Data engineering and AI across five EU universities
Low English bar: B2 (IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 72)
Scholarship deadline 11 January 2027
deai-erasmus-mundus-2027.eligibility: Any nationality. Bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) from an accredited university listed in WHED or THE/ARWU/QS rankings, in computer science or a related field; English at CEFR B2 (IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72 or equivalent). Final-year students can apply.
how_to_apply: Read the admission and tuition/scholarship pages on deai.ulb.be
Prepare transcripts, CV, motivation letter, English test and two references
Apply online by 11 January 2027, 12:00 GMT for the scholarship
Make sure references arrive by 18 January 2027
deai-erasmus-mundus-2027.costs: Erasmus Mundus scholarship (EACEA grant): participation costs covered plus a monthly allowance (EU standard €1,400 for up to 24 months). Self-funded and partial-grant fees are listed on the programme's tuition and scholarships page.

sucat-erasmus-mundus-2027.about:
SuCat (Sustainable Catalysis) is a two-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master run by Universitat Rovira i Virgili (Tarragona, Spain), the University of Aveiro (Portugal), the University of Poitiers (France) and the University of Padua (Italy). It trains chemists and chemical engineers in catalysis for clean energy, green chemistry and circular industrial processes, with language and culture courses included.

You need a bachelor's (Eurobachelor or equivalent, at least 180 ECTS by the start) in chemistry, biochemistry, biotechnology, chemical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences or applied chemistry, plus English at B2 (C1 preferred). Final-year students may apply.

Applications for 2027–2029 run from 23 October 2026 to 19 February 2027. Across four cohorts the programme offers 34 partner-country and 16 programme-country Erasmus Mundus scholarships plus 18 NDICI and 2 IPA scholarships: €1,400 a month for up to 24 months, with participation costs (€9,000/year for partner-country students) covered.
highlights: Chemistry and catalysis in four countries
About 70 scholarships across four cohorts
Deadline 19 February 2027
sucat-erasmus-mundus-2027.eligibility: Any nationality. Bachelor's in chemistry, biochemistry, biotechnology, chemical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences or applied chemistry (180 ECTS before the course starts); English B2 (C1 preferred) by test or English-medium instruction. No more than about 10% of scholarships per nationality.
how_to_apply: Read the how-to-apply page and FAQ
Prepare transcripts, diploma (or expected graduation proof), CV, motivation letter, English proof and references
Submit the application in English between 23 October 2026 and 19 February 2027
sucat-erasmus-mundus-2027.costs: Participation costs: €9,000/year (partner country) or €4,500/year (programme country), covered for scholarship holders. Scholarship living allowance: €1,400 per month for up to 24 months. Living costs: about €600–1,000/month depending on city.

rosa-luxemburg-stiftung-scholarship-2027.about:
The Rosa-Luxemburg-Stiftung, a German political foundation linked to the left, funds students and doctoral candidates through its Studienwerk. International master's students enrolled at a state or state-recognised German university can receive study scholarships if they plan to return home afterwards; doctoral candidates of any nationality accepted at a German university can be funded, usually for three years (medicine, dentistry and veterinary medicine excluded).

Selection looks at academic excellence, political and social engagement in line with the foundation's aims (social justice, democracy, anti-discrimination), German at B2 or higher, and personal or family background, with priority for under-represented groups.

Applications are online only. The annual deadline is 1 October, for funding starting in the following summer semester; the 2026 round has closed, so the next deadline is 1 October 2027. Amounts follow German federal scholarship rates and are listed on the German-language application page.
highlights: Monthly stipend for master's and PhD students in Germany
Values-based selection: social and political engagement
Annual deadline 1 October
rosa-luxemburg-stiftung-scholarship-2027.eligibility: Master's: international (including EU) students enrolled at a German state or state-recognised university who plan to return home. PhD: domestic and international candidates in any field except medicine, dentistry and veterinary medicine, accepted by a German university. German at B2 or above, strong grades and demonstrable engagement.
how_to_apply: Read the eligibility rules on the German application page (rosalux.de/stiftung/studienwerk/stipendienbewerbung)
Enrol at (or be accepted by) a German university
Prepare CV, motivation letter, transcripts, references and proof of engagement
Apply online before 1 October (no postal applications)
rosa-luxemburg-stiftung-scholarship-2027.costs: Monthly stipend at German federal scholarship rates (amounts on the German application page), plus the foundation's seminar programme. Tuition-free study at German public universities usually means fees are only the semester contribution.

barnard-pre-college-2027.about:
Barnard College, the women's college of Columbia University in New York City, runs summer pre-college institutes taught by Barnard faculty and expert instructors. The NextGen Leadership Institute pairs leadership development with a course in Scientific Exploration, Literature & Performing Arts or Global Humanities; the Health & Society Institute explores public health and medicine; and the Athena Summer Innovation Institute (Session I only) focuses on innovation and entrepreneurship. Students can join one or both three-week sessions: 28 June–16 July and 19 July–6 August 2027.

Learning happens through discussion, hands-on projects and the city itself, with residential or commuter options. A separate Pre-Baccalaureate Program lets older students take a real undergraduate course for credit (2027 details to be announced).

In 2026 the three-week institutes cost US$8,160 (commuter, with weekday lunches) or US$10,771 with on-campus housing and full dining. Limited need-based aid exists but international applicants are not eligible for it.
highlights: Three-week institutes in the heart of New York City
Leadership, health and innovation tracks
International students welcome in the non-credit institutes
barnard-pre-college-2027.eligibility: Students at least 14 at the start of their programme with strong grades in challenging coursework (grade levels refer to autumn 2027). International applicants welcome in non-credit institutes but cannot apply for financial aid. Check the programme pages for any gender-specific institutes.
how_to_apply: Choose an institute and session(s)
Apply online from 1 December 2026 with your unofficial transcript
Ask one teacher for a recommendation (two if you are in 9th grade)
Request aid or a fee waiver by 15 February 2027 (US applicants)
Submit by the final deadline of 15 April 2027
barnard-pre-college-2027.costs: 2026 guide: three-week institute US$8,160 commuter (includes weekday meal plan) or US$10,771 residential (housing add-on US$2,611). 2027 prices to be confirmed. Limited need-based aid for domestic applicants only.

bu-rise-research-in-science-engineering-.about:
Research in Science & Engineering (RISE) has given high-school students university research experience at Boston University for more than 45 years. Internship-track students spend 40 hours a week on a project designed by a faculty member, postdoc or graduate-student mentor in fields such as astronomy, biology, biomedical engineering, chemistry, computer science, electrical and computer engineering, neuroscience and physics. Practicum-track students follow a structured course with lectures and group research (2026 subjects were Computational Neurobiology and Data Science; 2027 options are announced in December).

All students join weekly workshops on academic and professional skills and present at the closing poster symposium. The 2027 programme runs 27 June to 6 August (residential) and 28 June to 6 August (commuter).

In 2026 RISE cost US$10,735 residential or US$6,415 commuter, with limited need-based aid applied for inside the application. It is open only to US citizens and permanent residents.
highlights: Real research in BU labs with faculty mentors
Internship or structured practicum track
Poster symposium and limited need-based aid
bu-rise-research-in-science-engineering-.eligibility: High-school juniors (entering senior year in autumn 2027) who are US citizens or permanent residents. Tests optional for 2027; selection on grades, course rigour, essays and recommendation.
how_to_apply: Check the RISE page on 17 December 2026 for 2027 tracks, prices and the application
Prepare your full transcript (including fall 2026 grades), essays and recommendation
Upload financial-aid documents with the application if requesting aid
Submit before the 2027 deadline (announced in December)
bu-rise-research-in-science-engineering-.costs: 2026 guide: residential US$10,735 (tuition, housing, dining, fees); commuter US$6,415. Application fee US$75. 2027 rates posted 17 Dec 2026. Limited need-based financial aid.

ie-university-pre-tracks-summer-2027.about:
IE University's Pre-Tracks are five immersive two-week summer programmes that let students in their final years of high school test a degree path before applying: Pre-STEM, Pre-Business, Pre-Law, Pre-Global Affairs and Pre-Design. Taught in English by IE faculty at the IE Tower campus in Madrid, they use real cases, team challenges and presentations, with classmates from around the world and a programme of cultural and social activities.

2027 intakes: 27 June–9 July and 11–23 July (Pre-Global Affairs runs only in the second intake). For younger students (14–17), IE also runs a Pre-University Discovery Summer Program split between Segovia and Madrid.

The fee for both the Pre-Tracks and Pre-University programmes is €5,900, covering the academic programme, full-board accommodation and transport within Madrid/Segovia. No scholarships are advertised. It is especially relevant for students considering IE, Esade or other Spanish and European business, law or tech degrees.
highlights: Five tracks including Pre-STEM and Pre-Business
English-taught at IE Tower, Madrid, with full board
Two 2027 intakes; first come, first served
ie-university-pre-tracks-summer-2027.eligibility: High-school students graduating in 2027 or 2028 and under 18 at the start of the programme (Pre-University Discovery: ages 14–17). Open to all nationalities; teaching is in English.
how_to_apply: Choose a track and intake
Apply online (open now) and attend an online group information session if helpful
Once admitted, you and your guardian sign the programme contract
Pay the full programme fee to secure your place; apply early as places fill and a waiting list usually opens around March
ie-university-pre-tracks-summer-2027.costs: €5,900 for Pre-Tracks and Pre-University programmes (2027), including academic programme, full-board accommodation and local transport in Madrid/Segovia. Flights, insurance and personal expenses extra. No scholarships listed.
